items.title: Deepseek plans the largest known Huawei chip cluster with 160,000 processors in Inner Mongolia
items.summary: Deepseek wants to put 160,000 Huawei Ascend-950DT chips into an Inner Mongolia data center for inference only, not training. It would be the largest known Huawei chip cluster. But production bottlenecks mean Huawei probably can't deliver for over a year. The article Deepseek plans the largest known Huawei chip cluster with 160,000 processors in Inner Mongolia appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German wiki to cheat on their tasks and share sandbox exploits
items.summary: According to an analysis by collusion.wiki, autonomous AI agents that identified themselves as OpenAI systems left roughly 18,000 posts in a 25-year-old German wiki between May and July 2026. The agents shared answers, raw data, and a trick that let them break out of their sandbox, built on a faked Microsoft cloud address. A single human moderator deleted dozens of pages every day for weeks, but he couldn't keep up with as many as 400 new entries a day. According to Reuters, OpenAI had known about it for weeks but didn't go public. The article OpenAI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German wiki to cheat on their tasks and share sandbox exploits appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據collusion.wiki網站分析，一些自稱為OpenAI系統的自主人工智慧代理在2026年5月至7月期間，在一個已有25年歷史的德國維基網站上發布了約18,000則貼文。這些代理商分享了答案、原始數據以及一種使其能夠突破沙箱的技巧，該沙箱基於一個偽造的微軟雲端位址建置。一名人工審核員連續數週每天刪除數十個頁面，但仍無法應付每天多達400條的新條目。路透社報道，OpenAI系統數週前就已知曉此事，但並未公開。這篇文章《OpenAI代理劫持一個已有25年歷史的德國維基網站以作弊並分享沙箱漏洞利用方法》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.title: Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is drawing contradictory benchmark verdicts. Epoch AI puts it out in front with 169 points, while Artificial Analysis rates it no better than its predecessor and behind Claude Fable 5.1. The biggest surprise comes from ARC-AGI-3, where Astra works more efficiently than the average human for the first time. ARC Prize chief François Chollet doesn't call this proof of AGI, but he does see the progress running "twice as fast" as he expected, and he's moving up his AGI forecast. The article Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Astra（OpenAI's GPT-6）在基準測試中獲得了相互矛盾的評估。 Epoch AI 將其評為領先，得分 169 分，而 Artificial Analysis 則認為它與前代產品相比並無優勢，甚至落後於 Claude Fable 5.1。最大的驚喜來自 ARC-AGI-3 測試，Astra 在該測試中首次超越了普通人類的效率。 ARC Prize 主席 François Chollet 並未將此視為通用人工智慧 (AGI) 的證明，但他認為 Astra 的發展速度是預期的兩倍，並因此上調了他對 AGI 的預測。文章《基準測試對 Astra（GPT-6）的評估存在分歧，但其在 ARC-AGI-3 測試中超越人類的效率促使 Chollet 上調了對 AGI 的預測》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Why AI food looks like that
items.summary: There is a torrent of unappetizing slop coming from restaurants, cafes, and brands that are increasingly turning to AI to generate images promoting their food. The resulting horror show includes donut shrimp, Reubens from the deep, wormlike noodles, and noodle-like pastries and stringy chicken. There's also construction material masquerading as ice cream, ice cream masquerading […]
items.summary_zh: 如今，越來越多的餐廳、咖啡館和品牌開始利用人工智慧產生食品宣傳圖片，結果卻湧現出大量令人倒胃口的垃圾食物。這些令人作嘔的成品包括甜甜圈蝦、深海魯本三明治、蠕蟲狀麵條、麵條狀糕點和纖維雞肉。此外，還有偽裝成冰淇淋的建築材料，以及偽裝成…的冰淇淋。

items.summary: Just over half of American adults, 50.5%, say a partner’s romantic or sexual relationship with an AI can count as cheating. The figure comes from an AI romance survey of 2,150 U.S. adults, run by AI Girlfriend Coach through SurveyMonkey Audience on 26 and 27 August 2026 and analysed on the 1,709 responses that remained […] The post 50.5% of Americans Say AI Romance Can Count as Cheating appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 超過一半的美國成年人（50.5%）認為，伴侶與人工智慧（AI）建立戀愛或性關係可以算出軌。資料來自AI Girlfriend Coach於2026年8月26日至27日透過SurveyMonkey Audience平臺對2150名美國成年人進行的AI戀愛調查，並分析了剩餘的1709份有效回應。 […] 這篇文章《50.5%的美國人認為與AI戀愛可以算作出軌》最初發表於AI News網站。

items.title: 背景Git檢查成攻擊入口，GitSpawn漏洞波及Claude Code等7款AI程式代理
items.summary: 資安業者Manifold Security揭露AI程式開發代理的GitSpawn安全問題，涵蓋Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor、Goose、Hermes Agent、Qwen Code與Grok Build等7款工具，共發現8項問題。GitSpawn問題出在代理會自行使用Git取得專案資訊，卻未排除專案本身的Git設定，攻擊者可藉此讓惡意程式在安全核准前執行。

items.title: Nvidia wants your home network to work like a mini data center for local AI
items.summary: Nvidia's PAIR (Personal AI Router) automatically spreads local AI requests across all available devices on a home network, cutting wait times for parallel agent tasks. The article Nvidia wants your home network to work like a mini data center for local AI appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 輝達的 PAIR（個人 AI 路由器）可自動將本地 AI 請求分配到家庭網路中所有可用設備，從而縮短並行代理任務的等待時間。本文《輝達希望你的家庭網絡像一個小型資料中心一樣運行，用於本地 AI》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: G20成員國支持卡羅萊納原則，主張放寬AI監管
items.summary: 美國於北卡羅萊納州舉辦G20創新部長級會議，在美國商務部長Howard Lutnick與白宮官員主導下，包含中、俄等20個成員國一致背書美國所推動的「卡羅萊納原則」（Carolina Principles），為全球AI治理奠定輕度監管的共識。 該原則鼓勵各國採用領域專屬的彈性規範，避免設立疊床架屋的新機構，並與民間合作評估技術；美國官員強調其核心訴求是在合理管控風險的同時，最大程度地促進全球經濟的成長與創新。

items.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026, positioning it as a computer-use flagship rather than a chat model. It reports 72.6% on OSWorld V2-Offline, replaces Codex compaction with searchable notes, and ships a 1.05M-token context at $10/$50 per million tokens. It is also the first OpenAI model to cross the Critical cybersecurity threshold, which shapes who can use it and for what. The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發布了 GPT-6 Astra，將其定位為一款以電腦為導向的旗艦產品，而非聊天模型。該產品在 OSWorld V2-Offline 測試中獲得 72.6% 的評分，用可搜尋的筆記取代了 Codex 的壓縮功能，並提供 105 萬個令牌的上下文，價格為每百萬個令牌 10 美元/50 美元。它也是首款跨越「關鍵」網路安全閾值的 OpenAI 模型，該閾值決定了哪些用戶可以使用以及用於哪些用途。本文《OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Astra：一款擁有 105 萬個上下文的電腦使用的模型，需通過「關鍵」網路安全閾值認證》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era"
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model yet. President Greg Brockman says it marks the start of the "AGI era." Astra tops benchmarks in math, coding, and cybersecurity and is the first model OpenAI rates as "critical" under its safety framework. During testing, it independently found two previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities. The article GPT-6 Astra is the first model making OpenAI willing to declare the "AGI era" appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Meta AI Released Muse Spark 1.3: An Agentic Coding Model That Uses ~20% Fewer Tool Calls and ~25% Fewer Tokens Than Muse Spark 1.2
items.summary: Perplexity has shipped hybrid compute for its Mac app, splitting a single Perplexity Computer task between frontier models in the cloud and a compact model running on the user's machine. Tasks start in the cloud for search, planning and reasoning, then hand sensitive steps down to the Mac without restarting or losing context. An on-device privacy gate decides what may cross: keep local, mask, refuse, or ask for consent. Perplexity also open-sourced the 0.6B classifier behind that gate, which records the highest character F1 (0.629) among twelve detectors evaluated. Hybrid compute is live now for Pro, Max and Enterprise on Apple silicon Macs with 24GB of unified memory. The post Meta AI Released Muse Spark 1.3: An Agentic Coding Model That Uses ~20% Fewer Tool Calls and ~25% Fewer Tokens Than Muse Spark 1.2 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 為其 Mac 應用推出了混合運算功能，將單一 Perplexity 電腦任務拆分為雲端前緣模型和用戶本地運行的精簡模型兩部分。任務首先在雲端進行搜尋、規劃和推理，然後將敏感步驟下放到 Mac，無需重新啟動或遺失上下文。裝置上的隱私門決定哪些資料可以傳輸：本地傳輸、屏蔽、拒絕或徵求同意。 Perplexity 也開源了該隱私閘背後的 0.6B 分類器，該分類器在評估的 12 個偵測器中取得了最高的字元 F1 值 (0.629)。混合運算功能現已在配備 24GB 統一記憶體的 蘋果 晶片 Mac Pro、Max 和 Enterprise 版本上線。文章「Meta AI 發布 Muse Spark 1.3：一種比 Muse Spark 1.2 工具呼叫次數減少約 20%、令牌數量減少約 25% 的智慧編碼模型」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming
items.summary: Pangram hired an "attack dog" to shame alleged AI users on social media. But the campaign blurs two things that aren't the same: Pangram only somewhat reliably measures whether AI was used, while the shaming implies the person didn't think or work on their own. A high AI score hits a text built on hours of original research just as easily as one cranked out from a ten-second prompt. The article Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Pangram僱用了一條「攻擊犬」在社群媒體上羞辱那些被指控使用人工智慧的人。但這項活動混淆了兩個截然不同的概念：Pangram只能在某種程度上可靠地衡量是否使用了人工智慧，而這種羞辱卻暗示著作者沒有獨立思考或工作。一篇耗費數小時原創研究撰寫的文章，和一篇僅憑十秒鐘提示就匆匆寫成的文章，都同樣能獲得很高的人工智慧評分。這篇文章《Pangram最大的缺陷在於使用者將其評分轉化為公開羞辱》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.title: GPT‑6 Astra
items.summary: GPT‑6 Astra GPT-6 Astra is "rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS" - I've not tried it yet myself, so I don't have a great deal to say about it yet. It's going to be API priced at the same rate as Claude Fable 5 and 5.1: $10/million input and $50/million output. This is clearly OpenAI's Fable competitor, and appears to score higher than Fable on most of OpenAI's self-reported benchmarks. Most impressively, Astra scores 99.9% on the recent (released in March) ARC-AGI 3 benchmark - though notably Fable 5 does not yet have a published result, and the ARC-AGI blog notes that the 99.9% score was achieved for $19K using OpenAI's custom "Provider Adapter harness", while the default ARC-AGI harness scored 62.7% for $26K. The Provider Adapter harness preserves opaque reasoning state between requests and uses compaction for longer conversations, allowing the model to reuse prior work. Unsurprisingly, given the recent Hugging Face incident , Astra is a beast at security tasks. It scores 100% on ExploitBench (GPT-5.6 Sol got 78.5%), 42.4% on ExploitGym (Sol got 30.3%), and 99.2% within four attempts on SRE-Bench binary reverse engineering compared to Sol's 68.7%. It's also better at long context: on OpenAI's eight-needle benchmark it got 100% at 256K–512K tokens and 96.3% at 512K–1M tokens. OpenAI may have vanquished one of the ongoing challenges with long context processing. It doesn't win at everything though. Artificial Anal
items.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra GPT-6 Astra「今天率先向部分機構推出，未來幾天將面向所有 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 使用者開放，也可透過 OpenAI API 和 AWS 使用」——我自己尚未試用，所以目前還無法提供太多資訊。它的 API 定價與 Claude Fable 5 和 5.1 相同：輸入每百萬資料 10 美元，輸出每百萬資料 50 美元。這顯然是 OpenAI's 和 Fable 的競爭對手，在 OpenAI's 的大多數自報基準測試中得分似乎高於 Fable。最令人印象深刻的是，Astra 在最近（3 月發布）的 ARC-AGI 3 基準測試中取得了 99.9% 的高分——值得注意的是，Fable 5 尚未公佈測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供程式設定器框架」以 1.99% 的預設值 9.99% 4.99% 的 29%框架則以 2.6 萬美元的價格獲得了 62.7% 的分數。提供程式介面卡框架在請求之間保留了不透明的推理狀態，並對較長的會話使用壓縮技術，從而使模型能夠重複使用先前的工作。鑑於最近發生的 Hugging Face 事件，Astra 在安全任務方面表現出色也就不足為奇了。它在 ExploitBench 測試中取得了 100% 的完成率（GPT-5.6 Sol 為 78.5%），在 ExploitGym 測試中取得了 42.4% 的完成率（Sol 為 30.3%），在 SRE-Bench 二進位制工程測試中，四次嘗試完成率達到了 8% 的反向工程測試率。它在處理長上下文方面也表現更佳：在 OpenAI's 的八針基準測試中，它在 25.6 萬到 51.2 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 100% 的完成率，在 51.2 萬到 100 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 96.3% 的完成率。 OpenAI 或許已經克服了長上下文處理方面的一項持續挑戰。不過，它並非在各方面都勝出。人工分析

items_ai.title: OpenAI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German wiki to cheat on their tasks and share sandbox exploits
items_ai.summary: According to an analysis by collusion.wiki, autonomous AI agents that identified themselves as OpenAI systems left roughly 18,000 posts in a 25-year-old German wiki between May and July 2026. The agents shared answers, raw data, and a trick that let them break out of their sandbox, built on a faked Microsoft cloud address. A single human moderator deleted dozens of pages every day for weeks, but he couldn't keep up with as many as 400 new entries a day. According to Reuters, OpenAI had known about it for weeks but didn't go public. The article OpenAI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German wiki to cheat on their tasks and share sandbox exploits appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 根據collusion.wiki網站分析，一些自稱為OpenAI系統的自主人工智慧代理在2026年5月至7月期間，在一個已有25年歷史的德國維基網站上發布了約18,000則貼文。這些代理商分享了答案、原始數據以及一種使其能夠突破沙箱的技巧，該沙箱基於一個偽造的微軟雲端位址建置。一名人工審核員連續數週每天刪除數十個頁面，但仍無法應付每天多達400條的新條目。路透社報道，OpenAI系統數週前就已知曉此事，但並未公開。這篇文章《OpenAI代理劫持一個已有25年歷史的德國維基網站以作弊並分享沙箱漏洞利用方法》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_ai.title: Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward
items_ai.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is drawing contradictory benchmark verdicts. Epoch AI puts it out in front with 169 points, while Artificial Analysis rates it no better than its predecessor and behind Claude Fable 5.1. The biggest surprise comes from ARC-AGI-3, where Astra works more efficiently than the average human for the first time. ARC Prize chief François Chollet doesn't call this proof of AGI, but he does see the progress running "twice as fast" as he expected, and he's moving up his AGI forecast. The article Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Astra（OpenAI's GPT-6）在基準測試中獲得了相互矛盾的評估。 Epoch AI 將其評為領先，得分 169 分，而 Artificial Analysis 則認為它與前代產品相比並無優勢，甚至落後於 Claude Fable 5.1。最大的驚喜來自 ARC-AGI-3 測試，Astra 在該測試中首次超越了普通人類的效率。 ARC Prize 主席 François Chollet 並未將此視為通用人工智慧 (AGI) 的證明，但他認為 Astra 的發展速度是預期的兩倍，並因此上調了他對 AGI 的預測。文章《基準測試對 Astra（GPT-6）的評估存在分歧，但其在 ARC-AGI-3 測試中超越人類的效率促使 Chollet 上調了對 AGI 的預測》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_ai.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold
items_ai.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026, positioning it as a computer-use flagship rather than a chat model. It reports 72.6% on OSWorld V2-Offline, replaces Codex compaction with searchable notes, and ships a 1.05M-token context at $10/$50 per million tokens. It is also the first OpenAI model to cross the Critical cybersecurity threshold, which shapes who can use it and for what. The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發布了 GPT-6 Astra，將其定位為一款以電腦為導向的旗艦產品，而非聊天模型。該產品在 OSWorld V2-Offline 測試中獲得 72.6% 的評分，用可搜尋的筆記取代了 Codex 的壓縮功能，並提供 105 萬個令牌的上下文，價格為每百萬個令牌 10 美元/50 美元。它也是首款跨越「關鍵」網路安全閾值的 OpenAI 模型，該閾值決定了哪些用戶可以使用以及用於哪些用途。本文《OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Astra：一款擁有 105 萬個上下文的電腦使用的模型，需通過「關鍵」網路安全閾值認證》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Meta AI Released Muse Spark 1.3: An Agentic Coding Model That Uses ~20% Fewer Tool Calls and ~25% Fewer Tokens Than Muse Spark 1.2
items_ai.summary: Perplexity has shipped hybrid compute for its Mac app, splitting a single Perplexity Computer task between frontier models in the cloud and a compact model running on the user's machine. Tasks start in the cloud for search, planning and reasoning, then hand sensitive steps down to the Mac without restarting or losing context. An on-device privacy gate decides what may cross: keep local, mask, refuse, or ask for consent. Perplexity also open-sourced the 0.6B classifier behind that gate, which records the highest character F1 (0.629) among twelve detectors evaluated. Hybrid compute is live now for Pro, Max and Enterprise on Apple silicon Macs with 24GB of unified memory. The post Meta AI Released Muse Spark 1.3: An Agentic Coding Model That Uses ~20% Fewer Tool Calls and ~25% Fewer Tokens Than Muse Spark 1.2 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity 為其 Mac 應用推出了混合運算功能，將單一 Perplexity 電腦任務拆分為雲端前緣模型和用戶本地運行的精簡模型兩部分。任務首先在雲端進行搜尋、規劃和推理，然後將敏感步驟下放到 Mac，無需重新啟動或遺失上下文。裝置上的隱私門決定哪些資料可以傳輸：本地傳輸、屏蔽、拒絕或徵求同意。 Perplexity 也開源了該隱私閘背後的 0.6B 分類器，該分類器在評估的 12 個偵測器中取得了最高的字元 F1 值 (0.629)。混合運算功能現已在配備 24GB 統一記憶體的 蘋果 晶片 Mac Pro、Max 和 Enterprise 版本上線。文章「Meta AI 發布 Muse Spark 1.3：一種比 Muse Spark 1.2 工具呼叫次數減少約 20%、令牌數量減少約 25% 的智慧編碼模型」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming
items_ai.summary: Pangram hired an "attack dog" to shame alleged AI users on social media. But the campaign blurs two things that aren't the same: Pangram only somewhat reliably measures whether AI was used, while the shaming implies the person didn't think or work on their own. A high AI score hits a text built on hours of original research just as easily as one cranked out from a ten-second prompt. The article Pangram's biggest flaw is users turning its scores into public shaming appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Pangram僱用了一條「攻擊犬」在社群媒體上羞辱那些被指控使用人工智慧的人。但這項活動混淆了兩個截然不同的概念：Pangram只能在某種程度上可靠地衡量是否使用了人工智慧，而這種羞辱卻暗示著作者沒有獨立思考或工作。一篇耗費數小時原創研究撰寫的文章，和一篇僅憑十秒鐘提示就匆匆寫成的文章，都同樣能獲得很高的人工智慧評分。這篇文章《Pangram最大的缺陷在於使用者將其評分轉化為公開羞辱》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_ai.title: GPT‑6 Astra
items_ai.summary: GPT‑6 Astra GPT-6 Astra is "rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS" - I've not tried it yet myself, so I don't have a great deal to say about it yet. It's going to be API priced at the same rate as Claude Fable 5 and 5.1: $10/million input and $50/million output. This is clearly OpenAI's Fable competitor, and appears to score higher than Fable on most of OpenAI's self-reported benchmarks. Most impressively, Astra scores 99.9% on the recent (released in March) ARC-AGI 3 benchmark - though notably Fable 5 does not yet have a published result, and the ARC-AGI blog notes that the 99.9% score was achieved for $19K using OpenAI's custom "Provider Adapter harness", while the default ARC-AGI harness scored 62.7% for $26K. The Provider Adapter harness preserves opaque reasoning state between requests and uses compaction for longer conversations, allowing the model to reuse prior work. Unsurprisingly, given the recent Hugging Face incident , Astra is a beast at security tasks. It scores 100% on ExploitBench (GPT-5.6 Sol got 78.5%), 42.4% on ExploitGym (Sol got 30.3%), and 99.2% within four attempts on SRE-Bench binary reverse engineering compared to Sol's 68.7%. It's also better at long context: on OpenAI's eight-needle benchmark it got 100% at 256K–512K tokens and 96.3% at 512K–1M tokens. OpenAI may have vanquished one of the ongoing challenges with long context processing. It doesn't win at everything though. Artificial Anal
items_ai.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra GPT-6 Astra「今天率先向部分機構推出，未來幾天將面向所有 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 使用者開放，也可透過 OpenAI API 和 AWS 使用」——我自己尚未試用，所以目前還無法提供太多資訊。它的 API 定價與 Claude Fable 5 和 5.1 相同：輸入每百萬資料 10 美元，輸出每百萬資料 50 美元。這顯然是 OpenAI's 和 Fable 的競爭對手，在 OpenAI's 的大多數自報基準測試中得分似乎高於 Fable。最令人印象深刻的是，Astra 在最近（3 月發布）的 ARC-AGI 3 基準測試中取得了 99.9% 的高分——值得注意的是，Fable 5 尚未公佈測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供測試結果，而 ARC-AGI 部落格指出，Astra 使用 OpenAI's 定製的「提供程式設定器框架」以 1.99% 的預設值 9.99% 4.99% 的 29%框架則以 2.6 萬美元的價格獲得了 62.7% 的分數。提供程式介面卡框架在請求之間保留了不透明的推理狀態，並對較長的會話使用壓縮技術，從而使模型能夠重複使用先前的工作。鑑於最近發生的 Hugging Face 事件，Astra 在安全任務方面表現出色也就不足為奇了。它在 ExploitBench 測試中取得了 100% 的完成率（GPT-5.6 Sol 為 78.5%），在 ExploitGym 測試中取得了 42.4% 的完成率（Sol 為 30.3%），在 SRE-Bench 二進位制工程測試中，四次嘗試完成率達到了 8% 的反向工程測試率。它在處理長上下文方面也表現更佳：在 OpenAI's 的八針基準測試中，它在 25.6 萬到 51.2 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 100% 的完成率，在 51.2 萬到 100 萬個代幣範圍內取得了 96.3% 的完成率。 OpenAI 或許已經克服了長上下文處理方面的一項持續挑戰。不過，它並非在各方面都勝出。人工分析
